dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: The wise always take orders from fools... Oh, sorry. Did you need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you an engineer?

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I guess. I'm lucky enough to have the skills needed to make a living here helping the guards fix things.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I don't know what my former colleagues would think if they saw me now... But I'm happy with the way things are, and that's enough, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Fortress of Meropide's clockwork meka...

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: The ones found here are all standard models. Not much to say about them. Now, if I were to upgrade them... Ah, why even bother thinking about it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Well then, goodbye,

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: We meet again! Great to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Not good, but not bad either. Which is excellent for me. What about you? Is everything going smoothly lately?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Fontaine Research Institute...

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I have nothing to say about that. I'd rather keep my memories about that place and its people to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I do run into my former colleagues here sometimes. But I was never very well-known.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I don't think they recognize me as a former employee of the Fontaine Research Institute. Which makes life easier for me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got something to do. See you later.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Hope it goes well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Smooth sailing.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I think if it was you, even if you ran into difficulty you'd be able to deal with it without breaking a sweat.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Haha. That sounded like I was being sarcastic, didn't it? But I really do think so. You and I are made of completely different stuff, and I can see your quality.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hard to say...

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Not so smooth then, it seems. Well, that's unavoidable. If you keep moving forward and facing new challenges you have to expect some obstacles and problems along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: But you have the courage to overcome those obstacles and the wisdom to solve those problems. Any setbacks are merely temporary, right?
